source_review.fresh: Reads Hopper and Vanda sequentially before campaign view validation.
source_review.heartbeat: After fresh view and native snapshot persistence, writes heartbeat by separate SSH RPC. View must be younger than120s; lease and bothSTOP files checked.
source_review.transport: Vanda SSH RPC outer timeout120s; qstat subprocess timeout25s. No completed receipt is saved when outer subprocess times out.
source_review.watch: One try/except wraps fresh reads, heartbeat mutation, release calls and periodic auth; TimeoutExpired/ConnectionError are all labeled READ_ONLY_OBSERVATION_INTERRUPTION, sleep30, up to3 failures.
source_review.diagnostic_defect: Timeout receipt lacks phase/label/start timestamp. A heartbeat write timeout can be misclassified as read-only; generic retry cannot safely distinguish unknown mutation.

inference.first_timeout_location: After native snapshot at1792679399.093195, next operation is heartbeat RPC. First timeout120.110569s later matches outer RPC deadline. This strongly supports heartbeat RPC stage, but no per-call timeout journal proves whether the remote process started.
inference.no_later_successful_heartbeat: Terminal heartbeat readback still contains1792679334.4377499, consistent with watchdog expiry.
inference.loss_mechanism: No fresh verified owner heartbeat reached the training watchdog for more than300s.
inference.underlying_transport_or_site_cause: UNDETERMINED; no attribution to helper incident solely from temporal overlap.

cold_fix_specification: Journal each phase and request identity before RPC; append bounded success/error/elapsed receipt even on timeout.
Treat only explicit read-only observation timeouts as retryable.
On heartbeat write timeout, stop dependent actions and perform a read-only exact-identity heartbeat readback; do not retry unknown writes.
Keep source/run/job/request identity, STOP/lease, dual-platform queue checks and original300s watchdog.
Bound serial observation/heartbeat/auth work under the freshness deadline; do not renew from stale observations or loosen watcher thresholds.
CPU fault tests must cover read timeout, heartbeat unknown/matching/mismatched readback, aged view, STOP/closed lease, and no second publication on unknown write.
Deploy only in a separately registered cold owner after exact published-source/CI/readback; failed owner and immutable training capsule remain untouched.
